Rules for whoever takes this order: write the missing package as a **new file** in a repository (the next hourly run of the star numbers its lines and places its functions); never change a copied file; if a value has to be chosen rather than computed, raise a decision record first and link it here; close this issue with a link to the file and to a run of the assembly page that passes the acceptance check.
